name: A-level French (AQA 7652): No et moi and Au revoir les enfants

selected_options.text: Delphine de Vigan, No et moi
selected_options.film: Louis Malle, Au revoir les enfants

material_vintage: AQA A-level French (7652) specification, Version 1.1 (August 2026), linked from aqa.org.uk/7652 and itemised on 2026-09-27: the four themes and their 36 sub-theme bullets, the AS and A-level grammar lists (3.3.1.1-3.3.2.2), the ten set texts and six set films, and the individual research project. This course studies one text (No et moi) and one film (Au revoir les enfants); the other works are declared out of scope. Assessment: Paper 1 Listening, reading and writing (2 h 30, 100 marks, 50%: listening 30, reading 50, translation into English 10 and into French 10); Paper 2 Writing (2 h, 80 marks, 20%: one essay on the text and one on the film, about 300 words each); Paper 3 Speaking (21-23 minutes including 5 minutes' preparation, 60 marks, 30%: stimulus-card discussion 25 marks; research project presentation and discussion 35 marks). Stage tests and the mock are original materials in AQA's style.
level_source: RQF Level 3 (GCE A-level), per Ofqual's register listing for AQA 7652

learner_notices.text: This course studies No et moi and Au revoir les enfants. You need your own copy of the novel (unabridged) and access to the film; the course discusses them but does not reproduce them. If your school has chosen other works, you will need another source for Paper 2.

The speaking exam is conducted by a teacher or visiting examiner and marked by AQA; this course prepares you with practice conversations but cannot hold the real test. Listening practice here uses French passages you read aloud or have read to you; add authentic audio (for example RFI's 'Journal en français facile').
